description:
About the job

About us




Glitch is an AI-native ads platform based in Dublin, Ireland. The platform runs Google Ads Search across a growing book of client accounts, with a specialist ad operations team working alongside it. The book keeps growing, so we are adding an Ad Operations Specialist to build and optimise accounts to a consistent standard.




The role

This is a full time contract role. You will own the day-to-day build and optimisation work on live Google Ads Search accounts. Our service is Search only, brand and non-brand prospecting, so you can go deep on one discipline instead of spreading thin across channels. The platform creates the campaign builds and a house optimisation playbook defines the process, so your job is to execute it precisely and improve accounts on the numbers. You report to the Head of Ad Operations & Optimisation.




What you will do

Review the platform's campaign creation. Review the campaign builds the Glitch platform creates: ad groups, phrase and exact keywords, negatives, and responsive search ads. Run the launch QA checklist in Google Ads Editor and fix anything that needs it before it goes live.




Optimise live accounts for conversions. Work live accounts towards target CPA and CPL following the house optimisation playbook: search terms audits, negative keyword work, budget and bid changes. Every decision is conversion-first, not vanity-metric-first.




Log platform bugs clearly. When you spot a bug or an anomaly in the Glitch platform, log it with clear reproduction notes so the product team can find and fix it fast.




Recommend strategy improvements with evidence. Read the account data and flag what should change. Bring the recommendation and the evidence behind it, not a hunch.




Write client-facing performance summaries. Produce performance summaries and reports as needed, written clearly enough for a non-technical business owner to understand what happened and what comes next.




What we need
2+ years hands-on Google Ads Search experience managing live budgets, not just observing accounts
Proficiency in Google Ads Editor for building and bulk-editing campaigns
Conversion tracking literacy: conversion actions, and the basics of tCPA and tROAS bidding
Process discipline: you follow the launch QA checklist exactly and you document your work
English fluency, written and spoken




Nice to have
Multi-account or client-service background, for example experience at an agency managing several accounts at once
Google Ads certification is a plus




Location and hours

The role is fully remote working US hours. 




Compensation

$1500 to $2000 per month depending on experience




Hiring process
Application review
A short, practical Google Ads task
Interview with the Head of Ad Operations
2nd interview with senior management
Offer




How to apply

Send your resume along with a cover letter outlining why you think you would be a great fit for the role.

description:
About the job

Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?

At  Aleph , we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

Ready to accelerate your career in Gaming? Want to shape the future of advertising on Roblox?

We are looking for a high-energy, AI-native Client Partner to join our team at Aleph, focusing specifically on Roblox in Mexico.

If you live and breathe technology, love the gaming industry, and use AI tools to supercharge your daily life, this is the perfect place to build your future.

Who You Are

We are looking for a dynamic professional who brings a fresh perspective, immense drive, and a passion for innovation.



Growth Mindset: You are eager to fast-track your professional journey, master new skills at lightning speed, and make a tangible impact from day one. 
"Full AI" Oriented: You don't just know what AI is, it’s woven into how you think and work. You actively use tools like Gemini, Claude, or automation to learn, create, and organize your workflow. You are always looking for ways to leverage AI to work smarter. 
Tech or Gaming Enthusiast: You have a deep, genuine passion for the gaming industry (if you understand or play Roblox, that's a massive plus!) and you naturally gravitate toward the latest tech trends. 
High Energy & Hyper-Adaptable: The digital ad world moves fast, and Aleph moves faster. You thrive in environments of constant change, pivot smoothly when priorities shift, and bring infectious positive energy to the team. 



What You’ll Do

As a Client Partner for Roblox, you will be at the intersection of brands, gaming, and cutting-edge ad tech:



Help brands and agencies understand the power of Roblox and how to build successful campaigns. 
Use AI tools to optimize your workflow, build pitches, analyze data, and stay ahead of the curve. 
Manage client relationships with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. 
Collaborate with a global, fast-paced team where innovation is celebrated. 



Why Join Us?



The Brand: Represent Roblox, one of the most exciting and dynamic platforms in the world. 
The Culture: At Aleph, change is our constant. You will be surrounded by brilliant minds in a flexible, high-growth environment. 
The Future: We don't just tolerate AI; we expect you to push the boundaries of how it's used to elevate your daily work. 



 Ready to jump in? If you are energetic, adaptable, and ready to kickstart your growth at the intersection of AI and Gaming, let’s talk!

Why Join Us?

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

#ALEPH

description:
About the job

¿QUIÉNES SOMOS? 🚀




En Nexxia ayudamos a las organizaciones a transformar datos en decisiones estratégicas. Combinamos analítica, tecnología y conocimiento de negocio para desarrollar soluciones que generan valor medible para nuestros clientes.

Creemos que los datos tienen el poder de impulsar mejores decisiones cuando se convierten en información clara, confiable y accionable.




SOBRE EL ROL 📊




Buscamos un@ Analista Jr. de Diseño de Negocio para integrarse al área de Estrategia. En esta posición, trabajarás en modalidad de apoyo directo con el Gerente de Nuevos Negocios. Tu propósito principal será convertir oportunidades de negocio validadas, en soluciones bien diseñadas, documentadas y trazables, listas para pasar a la etapa de Implementación.




Este no es un rol de ejecución de proyectos ni gestión de equipos de desarrollo, sino un rol de estructuración de decisiones. Actuarás como un puente clave, interactuando de forma autónoma con diversas áreas (Legal, Finanzas, Tecnología, Sales) para asegurar que cada decisión quede registrada con su razonamiento y sus supuestos.







RESPONSABILIDADES CLAVE 📈




Estructural y Documentación de decisiones (~50%)

Mantener organizada la documentación de decisiones de cada iniciativa: qué se decidió, por qué y bajo qué supuestos.
Redactar los primeros borradores de entregables clave como PRD, BRD y Service Blueprint para la revisión del Gerente.
Dar seguimiento a las dependencias entre decisiones dentro de un mismo proyecto y alertar cuando algo se construye sobre un supuesto no validado.

Soporte Analítico (~20%)

Realizar benchmarking de mercado y competencia para nutrir la fase de Discovery y validar mecánicas propuestas.
Apoyar en modelos financieros preliminares (inputs, escenarios simples, sensibilidad básica).
Calcular y refinar los KPIs de la iniciativa.
Ejecutar un gap analysis periódico para contrastar lo planeado contra el avance real.

Coordinación y Seguimiento (~30%)

Dar seguimiento al plan de trabajo de la etapa de diseño y a los hitos comprometidos.
Coordinar directamente con las áreas dueñas de cada dominio (Legal, Finanzas, Tecnología, Sales) para cerrar pendientes de documentación, sin necesidad de que el Gerente medie cada intercambio.
Preparar y documentar minutas de las revisiones periódicas de avance y supuestos abiertos.




LO QUE BUSCAMOS 🔍




1 a 2 años de experiencia mínima en consultoría, banca, análisis de negocio/producto, estrategia o roles similares.
Licenciatura en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial, Economía, Negocios o carrera afín.
Redacción clara y estructurada: Habilidad indispensable y no negociable, dado el gran peso del componente documental.
Rigor documental: Entender que una decisión no está cerrada hasta que queda registrada con su razonamiento y sus supuestos, no solo el "qué".
Tolerancia a la ambigüedad: Capacidad de tomar una conversación sin resolver y convertirla en una decisión documentable mediante un pensamiento estructurado y lógico.
Autonomía calibrada: Equilibrio para no quedarse trabado esperando instrucciones, pero tampoco avanzar a ciegas sobre un supuesto sin verificar.
Comunicación cross-funcional fluida: Facilidad para interactuar con múltiples áreas de forma directa y autónoma.
Deseable: Manejo de herramientas de documentación estructurada (Notion, Confluence o similar) y familiaridad con metodologías de Discovery y diseño de soluciones.
Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado.







NUESTRA CULTURA 💡




En Nexxia creemos que el talento se potencia cuando las personas pueden ser auténticas, sentirse valoradas y encontrar espacios donde sus ideas, experiencias y perspectivas realmente importan.

Nos apasiona construir equipos diversos porque sabemos que la innovación nace cuando nos atrevemos a pensar diferente, aprender unos de otros y colaborar con un propósito común. Por eso, impulsamos una cultura donde el respeto, la confianza y la cercanía son parte de la experiencia de cada persona.

Nos enorgullece crear un entorno en el que todos puedan desarrollarse, generar impacto y disfrutar el camino mientras construimos juntos prosperidad sostenible a través del conocimiento.

description:
About the job

About Us

SIPSOPA is a food innovation company revolutionizing the instant comfort food market by combining authentic global recipes with advanced freeze-drying technology to deliver flavorful, convenient, and nutritious soups. SIPSOPA is building a scalable development platform with proprietary formulations and a pipeline of more than 20 global soup flavors. The brand focuses on community, storytelling, and digital engagement to modernize the instant soup category while delivering authentic and nutritious global comfort in every cup.




Role Description

This is a contract-based remote role for a Retail Sales Manager. SIPSOPA's Regional Sales Manager owns our U.S. retail growth. This person wins new retail accounts directly and identifies, recruits, and manages the brokers and distributors that expand SIPSOPA's shelf presence across grocery, natural/specialty, mass, club, and convenience channels. The role is remote, ideally based in Mexico, and works with the founder remotely, with travel to the U.S. as required. Success requires deep U.S. retail fluency built during prior time working in the United States; this is not a role someone can learn on the job.




Key responsibilities

Retail account development

Identify, pursue, and secure new U.S. retail accounts across grocery, natural/specialty, mass, club, and convenience.
Build and maintain direct relationships with U.S. retail buyers and category managers. Own sell-in end-to-end; from first pitch through shelf placement.
Develop account-specific business plans, pricing and promotion proposals, and line-review presentations.

Broker and distributor management

Identify, evaluate, and onboard regional and national U.S. brokers and distributors aligned with SIPSOPA's growth strategy.
Set performance expectations, sales targets, and scorecards for broker and distributor partners, and manage them on an ongoing basis.
Coordinate with brokers on new-item submissions, trade shows, and retailer-specific programs.

Channel and market expansion

Expand SIPSOPA's presence into new U.S. retail channels and geographies, with a particular focus on Hispanic-forward retailers (Northgate, Vallarta, El Super, Fiesta Mart, Cardenas, Bravo) and mainstream chains with strong Hispanic sets.
Monitor category trends, competitor activity, and retailer dynamics to inform go-to-market strategy.
Represent SIPSOPA at U.S. trade shows and industry events, including Expo West, Fancy Food, and ECRM sessions.

Planning and reporting

Manage trade spend and promotional budgets within assigned accounts to maximize ROI, including deduction management.
Track and report on account performance, distribution gains, and broker results. Weekly update to the CEO.
Partner with the CEO on annual sales planning, forecasting, and budget development.

Strategy and planning

Create and drive the U.S. sales and go-to-market strategy to meet or exceed annual revenue and distribution goals.
Align sales strategy with SIPSOPA's brand positioning and resource envelope as an early-stage company.




Qualifications

Required

3–7 years CPG sales, with direct experience calling on U.S. retail accounts and managing broker or distributor relationships.
Prior work experience inside the United States in a CPG sales, account management, or category role — enough time that you know the buyers, the calendar, the deduction culture, and the way U.S. retail actually operates.
Active, current network of relationships with U.S. retail buyers, brokers, or distributors in at least one major channel (grocery, natural/specialty, mass, club, or convenience). Verifiable in the first interview.
Fully bilingual, English and Spanish, at business-professional level.
Valid passport and current U.S. visa allowing business travel (B1/B2 or better).
Comfortable operating remotely across the U.S.–Mexico time zones and traveling into the U.S. on short notice.
Self-starter energy. Comfortable with the flexibility, ambiguity, and personal ownership of an early-stage brand.
Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Proficiency with standard sales tools (CRM, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides).

Preferred

Existing relationships with regional or national U.S. brokers and distributors (KeHE, UNFI, DPI, Advantage, Acosta, or major regional brokers) that can be activated quickly.
Relationships at Hispanic-forward U.S. retailers or with the Hispanic buyer at mainstream chains.
Working fluency with syndicated data (Circana/IRI, NielsenIQ, SPINS) or retailer POS portals.
Experience with trade spend management and deduction resolution.
Prior work at a founder-led or fast-growth CPG startup (seed–Series B).
Category management coursework (CPCA or equivalent).
Cultural fluency with U.S. business norms.

description:
About the job

RTD (ready-to-drink) a base de mezcal, actualmente en lanzamiento comercial simultáneo en Ciudad de México, Los Cabos y Miami/Florida. La marca está construyendo su equipo comercial de campo desde cero. Formará la unidad comercial que abrirá y sostendrá el mercado de CDMX




El Account Manager recibe las cuentas que el Sales Rep ha abierto y cerrado, y a partir de ese momento es el responsable de la relación comercial: seguimiento, reposición, fidelización y crecimiento de la cartera. Su trabajo garantiza que lo que el Sales Representant conquista, la marca lo retiene y lo hace crecer.




Este perfil vive en la relación. Conoce a los compradores por nombre, entiende sus ciclos de reposición, anticipa sus necesidades y asegura que la marca de seltzers mantenga presencia activa en cada punto de venta ganado.







Canales de responsabilidad

• Off-trade: gestión activa de cuentas ya abiertas en tiendas especializadas, licorerías y supermercados.

• Distribuidores: seguimiento a los acuerdos cerrados por el Sales Rep, asegurando cumplimiento de volúmenes, condiciones y presencia de producto.




Zonas de cobertura

• Roma, Condesa y Juárez.

• Polanco, Lomas y Santa Fe.




Responsabilidades principales

• Recibir el handoff formal de cuentas cerradas por el Sales Rep con toda la información comercial relevante.

• Dar seguimiento periódico a cada cuenta activa: visitas de reposición, verificación de exhibición, resolución de incidencias.

• Mantener comunicación constante con compradores y responsables de categoría en los puntos de venta.

• Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento dentro de la cartera existente: nuevos SKUs, ampliación de exhibición, activaciones en punto de venta.

• Gestionar y dar seguimiento a los acuerdos con distribuidores activos: pedidos, entregas, cumplimiento de condiciones pactadas.

• Detectar señales de riesgo en cuentas (disminución de pedidos, problemas de rotación, cambio de compradores) y escalar a Dirección Comercial.

• Reportar de forma periódica estado de cartera, métricas de retención y oportunidades identificadas a Dirección Comercial.

• Coordinar con el Sales Rep para asegurar que los traspasos de cuentas sean ordenados y completos.

Mexico City, MX

The Partner Activation and Acceleration Specialist is an individual contributor role within the Strategy & Operations (S&O) team, part of Thomson Reuters' Partnerships & Alliances organization. This role is both partner-facing and internally focused: you will serve as a valued point of contact for partners through their onboarding and activation journey while driving the internal cross-functional coordination, process rigor, and operational discipline that makes partner success possible. You will be pivotal in reducing onboarding and activation time and improving time-to-revenue for both partners and TR across global segments, including Legal Professionals, Tax, Audit and Accounting Professionals, Corporates, and Government. You will execute and continuously improve the mechanisms and frameworks that accelerate partner sales, directly supporting TR's goal of a 3x increase in P&A sales contribution by 2028.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Commercial Excellence, Finance, Pricing, Legal, and Partner Specialists to embed partners at the core of TR's go-to-market, sales, and innovation processes. You will be expected to manage up to 15 partners concurrently, will ensure scalable, measurable, and partner-centric activation, and you will play a key role in the evolution of the Partner Activation and Acceleration Team (PAAT) operating model. This role requires high ownership, solutions orientation, comfort with ambiguity, and a relentless customer and partner obsession. You will operate in an environment where processes are still being built; the ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information and bring a proposed path forward with every problem is essential.

Own partner onboarding, activation, and acceleration across assigned regions and segments, reducing time-to-activation and improving partner time-to-revenue.

Collaborate with Partner Specialists, Sales, Commercial Excellence, Pricing, Legal, and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve partner issues and embed scalable activation practices into day-to-day operations.

About the job

Position Description

White Star Logistics is growing rapidly and remains committed to sustained expansion. As part of this growth, the organization has set a milestone of delivering 1,000,000 loads. Achieving this goal requires a Sales Manager capable of building a sales organization equipped to scale accordingly.

This position carries significant leadership responsibility: recruiting top sales talent, establishing coaching and accountability systems that ensure consistent performance, and assuming direct ownership of the team's revenue growth. This role is intended for an experienced sales leader rather than an individual contributor, someone who will build the sales infrastructure necessary for the company's next phase of growth.

Candidates with a demonstrated record of building and leading successful sales teams, and who are prepared to assume a role with substantial ownership, are encouraged to apply.




Location: US & Mexico Applicants Welcomed! 




We Are Looking For:

• Sales management experience – Proven experience directly managing a team of salespeople within freight brokerage or logistics.

• Recruiting and hiring instincts – A demonstrated ability to build sales teams from the ground up and identify strong talent.

• Coaching ability – Experience developing underperforming representatives into consistent, strong performers.

• Accountability mindset – Ability to manage a team against clearly defined activity and performance metrics, holding individuals accountable for measurable results.

• Process builder – Experience building or refining sales playbooks, pipeline reviews, and onboarding procedures.

• Team-first leader – A demonstrated focus on scaling team output rather than personal production.

What You Will Do:

• Recruit, interview, and hire sales talent to build out the team.

• Coach and develop salespeople, including improving the performance of underperforming representatives.

• Establish and enforce accountability to activity and performance metrics.

• Conduct regular pipeline reviews and sales meetings.

• Develop and refine sales processes, playbooks, and onboarding procedures for new representatives.

• Assume ownership of team-level GM-per-load and revenue growth targets, partnering with leadership on organizational scaling.

Qualifications:

• Minimum of three years managing a team of salespeople in freight brokerage or logistics.

• Demonstrated experience recruiting, hiring, and onboarding sales talent.

• Experience with specialized freight such as cross-border, drayage, intermodal, expedited, or project cargo transportation is preferred.

• Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is preferred but not required.

• Strong communication skills across phone, email, and video conferencing.

The Perks of Working with Us:

• Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision coverage.

• Remote work arrangement with the flexibility to work from home.

• Competitive salary with performance-based incentives tied to team growth and GM-per-load targets.

Core Values:

• Own It – We take responsibility for outcomes, not excuses.

• Find a Way – We are resourceful, resilient, and solution-oriented.

• Protect All Stakeholders – We protect customers, employees, carriers, vendors, and the company.

• Communicate Early – We communicate proactively, particularly when issues arise.

• Excellence Through Growth – We continuously pursue improvement across our team, ourselves, and our service.

• Develop People – We believe our greatest contribution is helping people realize more than they believed possible.




Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

description:
About the job

About Lendable
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:


One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people
Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
Profitable since 2017
Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)


So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting


About The Role
We're looking for a hands-on, customer-empathetic Credit Supervisor to own credit management, credit limit increases (CLI), and collections for our Mexico Credit Card. This is a founding role: you will build these frameworks and processes from the ground up.

The Lenda credit card is a mobile app–first product targeted at the credit builder segment in Mexico. We empower customers to access the formal financial ecosystem and build their credit profile over time, while offering a flexible and responsible line of credit tailored to their needs.

What makes this role different from a traditional credit management role is that you think about the customer experience as a credit lever. In a mobile-first, credit builder product, how customers experience the card — activation flows, payment reminders, limit increase offers — directly drives delinquency and engagement. You will work closely with Product and Operations to ensure the customer journey and credit performance reinforce each other.

We are looking for builders and doers that get things done.
In practice, this means being equally comfortable:


Defining and managing CLI eligibility, timing, and quality assurance
Designing collections strategies that balance recovery with customer empathy
Diving into portfolio metrics, roll rates, and delinquency trends
Collaborating with Product on customer-facing flows that influence credit behavior
Coordinating with Data Science, Operations, Compliance, and Customer Support
Driving operational excellence and automation within credit management processes
Having a deep understanding of how post-acquisition performance impacts our P&L


What You'll Be Responsible For
This role will cover all aspects of credit management and collections for our Mexico Credit Card, including:


Owning portfolio performance post-acquisition: delinquency rates, roll rates, loss curves, profitability
Designing and continuously improving the CLI framework — eligibility, timing, sizing, and quality assurance
Building and leading the collections strategy: early-stage treatments, communication flows, escalation paths, recovery rates
Monitoring management KPIs: DPD buckets, NPL rates, recovery rates, CLI uptake and performance
Identifying behavioral signals that predict delinquency and building proactive intervention strategies
Collaborating with Product on customer-facing flows (payment reminders, activation nudges, CLI offers) that influence credit behavior
Supporting customers experiencing financial difficulty with responsible, empathy-driven solutions
Working with Data Science to build and refine behavioral scoring and collections models
Ensuring compliance with Mexican financial regulations for collections and customer treatment
Improving operational efficiency through automation and tooling


You will have the freedom and responsibility to shape how credit is managed in Mexico from the ground up.

How You'll Work
Credit leaders at Lendable work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Compliance, and Growth to ensure strong portfolio health and sustainable expansion.

It's your job to:


Connect customer behavior patterns to portfolio risk outcomes
Prioritize interventions based on impact on delinquency and profitability
Balance commercial objectives with fair, empathy-driven customer outcomes
Experiment with new collections treatments, measure, and iterate quickly


We encourage all our teams to think big, act fast, and continuously improve.

Experience
You have a solid background in credit management, collections, or consumer lending. You're hands-on, customer-centric, and comfortable moving between strategy, execution, and analysis. Ideally, you bring:


Proficiency in English and Spanish
Solid understanding of credit management fundamentals: delinquency curves, roll rates, vintage analysis, recovery rates, P&L impact of collections
Experience in credit card or consumer lending portfolio management
Experience designing or managing collections strategies (early, mid, and late stage)
Comfort with SQL — you can independently query portfolio data to monitor performance and investigate anomalies
Experience leveraging AI tools to run analyses and drive faster decisions
Strong customer empathy — you understand that collections is a customer experience problem, not just a financial one
Good at communicating to different stakeholders
Strong ownership mentality and accountability for portfolio performance
Agency: you move fast, iterate based on feedback, and proactively flag issues before they escalate
Bonus: Experience thinking about UX or customer journey in the context of credit outcomes (activation, payment behavior, engagement)
Bonus: Experience in credit builder, thin-file, or underbanked segments
Bonus: Some experience on Fraud (especially first-party fraud in collections contexts)
Bonus: Experience in start-up/scale-up environments, credit cards, or fintech
Bonus: Familiarity with Mexican financial regulations for collections (CONDUSEF, CNBV)


The type of work you'll be doing

Own and drive credit management performance, strategy, and execution
Define and monitor KPIs related to delinquency, collections, CLI performance, and profitability
Lead CLI quality assurance and continuous improvement initiatives
Design and iterate on collections communication flows and treatment strategies

About the job

Sobre NTT DATA

Haz de este el lugar donde crezcas.

Como líder global en innovación empresarial y tecnológica, trabajamos con las mejores organizaciones a nivel mundial para entregar soluciones que generan un impacto significativo.

Con más de 190,000 profesionales en más de 70 países, combinamos un profundo conocimiento con una cultura que valora el aprendizaje, la curiosidad y la colaboración.

Lideramos la transformación y entregamos soluciones seguras, innovadoras y específicas de la industria que impulsan el crecimiento de los negocios. Nuestra gente impulsa todos nuestros logros, piensan en grande para entregar resultados mientras se asegura que cada voz sea escuchada.




Buscamos un Senior Business Analyst con experiencia en operaciones bancarias y conciliaciones financieras para participar en un proyecto estratégico de migración tecnológica.




¿Qué buscamos?

✔ 4-5 años o más como Business Analyst o Analista Funcional.

✔ Más de 3 años dentro del sector bancario.

✔ Conciliaciones bancarias

✔ Payments

✔ Treasury

✔ Cash Management

✔ Procesos operativos bancarios

✔ Experiencia trabajando con negocio y equipos de TI.

✔ Gestión de stakeholders.

Liderar el análisis funcional de procesos bancarios.

Validar requerimientos funcionales.
Gestionar riesgos funcionales.
Coordinar stakeholders de negocio y TI.
Asegurar la correcta definición funcional antes del desarrollo y pruebas.




Plus muy importantes: 

✔SmartStream TLM

✔Nostro Accounts

✔Regulatory Reporting

✔Accounting Controls

✔Migraciones tecnológicas




Este rol describe tu punto de partida en NTT DATA. Creemos en las relaciones a largo plazo y en apoyar tu desarrollo. A medida que tus habilidades y ambiciones evolucionen, trabajaremos contigo para identificar futuras oportunidades, proyectos y carreras profesionales dentro de nuestra organización.




🌟 ¿Por qué NTT DATA?

🤝 Una cultura de colaboración y apoyo

Fomentamos un entorno donde la curiosidad, la innovación, el compromiso y el trabajo en equipo son celebrados. Nuestra filosofía de “People first” es una de las razones principales por las que continuamos siendo reconocidos globalmente.

🚀 Desarrollo profesional y aprendizaje continuo

Accede a un camino de formación estructurado, recursos de aprendizaje continuos, revisiones de desempeño anuales y un programa de mentoría dedicado — todo diseñado para ayudarte a desarrollarte profesionalmente y asumir nuevos desafíos.

Como empresa, adoptamos un enfoque BeFlex que empodera a nuestra gente con flexibilidad para gestionar su jornada laboral.

✨ Top Empleador Global

Estamos orgullosamente certificados como Top Empleador Global, que refleja nuestro compromiso de ser un lugar donde las personas puedan desarrollarse y prosperar.

🌿 Salud y bienestar primero

Tu bienestar mental importa. Los empleados tienen acceso a psicólogos certificados y talleres de salud mental en línea.

🌈 Diversidad, Equidad e Inclusión

Estamos comprometidos a crear un lugar de trabajo donde todos puedan prosperar, sin importar género, nacionalidad, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad o contexto. La inclusión es parte de quiénes somos y cómo trabajamos.

#WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique

About the job

Location: Monterrey

About Springer Nature

Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.

Macmillan Education provides world-class content in the most relevant, engaging and flexible formats to support students, teachers and institutions in lifelong learning. Visit macmillaneducation.com and follow @MacmillanEducation / @MacmillanELT
